state: source and standards review completed; frozen patch execution pending

finding.title: Receipt status is not bound to the requested transaction hash
finding.severity_assessment: Conditional transaction-status integrity defect; no demonstrated fund theft, signing bypass, or protection against a consistently lying RPC.
finding.observed_behavior: The baseline checks status, blockNumber and optional destination but never reads transactionHash. submitTx can combine a correctly looked-up submitted transaction with a different receipt. buildReceipt then maps the submitted hash to included/reverted based on that receipt.
mitigations: Wallet-returned transaction hash is already validated and normalized.
verifySubmission compares hash/sender/destination/calldata/value and any supplied chain ID.
PostBroadcastError retains the original submitted hash and classifies verification as incomplete.
Local receipt is inclusion/status information, not confirmation-depth/finality proof.

facts: transactionHash is a required string matching 0x plus 64 hexadecimal characters in the current schema.
Receipt status distinguishes success and failure; it is not confirmation depth.
Method returns the receipt for the transaction specified by its 32-byte hash.
The receipt contains the transaction's 32-byte transactionHash.
Pending transactions do not have receipts.

primary_sources.status: Stagnant proposal; corroborating, not presented as finalized standard.
facts: Receipt identifies the transaction specified by hash; null when no transaction is found.
Data is 0x-prefixed hexadecimal with two digits per byte.

required_review_cases: Different valid hash must fail before success or reverted classification.
Missing/malformed/non-string hash must fail with stable safe receipt-shape error; no String coercion.
Matching canonical and supported uppercase-equivalent hash must preserve outcomes.
Pending null response, bounded retry count and sleep behavior remain unchanged.
Post-broadcast errors preserve submitted hash and cause; no automatic resubmission.
Existing destination, status and block-number handling remains scoped and unchanged.
RPC rejection/cancellation and sleep rejection preserve existing handling.
No added claim of finality, confirmation depth, cross-provider honesty or cryptographic receipt authenticity.
